task: VIRTUAL STAGING of a real photograph of an empty newly-built <ROOM>. Furnish it with warm minimalist contemporary luxury furniture, and remove construction leftovers. The ARCHITECTURE MUST NOT CHANGE AT ALL.
source: <descrierea fotografiei reale: pardoseala, pereti, tamplarie, radiatoare, ce se vede pe geam, ce resturi de santier sunt in cadru>
add_furniture: <piesele, cu material si pozitie fata de pereti>
remove: the toolbox and all building debris on the floor
the bare hanging light bulbs and their loose wires
any protective tape, plastic sheeting or wrapped objects
new_lighting: soft warm natural daylight entering from the existing openings, gentle realistic contact shadows under every piece of furniture, warm neutral white balance
style: real interior photography for a premium property listing, 35mm, natural perspective, photographic and restrained, NOT a 3D render
must_preserve_exactly: the exact camera angle, perspective, framing, crop and 4:3 aspect ratio
every wall position and the ceiling
every door and door frame, every window and window frame
the exact view through the glass, unchanged in content
the floor material, plank direction and colour
quality_bar: looks like the same room photographed after a real furniture delivery. Furniture sits flat on the floor with correct scale and perspective, correct contact shadows, no floating objects, no warped walls
negative_prompt: changed room shape, moved walls, removed radiator, changed floor, different view outside, different camera angle, recomposed, cropped, zoomed, square image, 3d render look, cgi, plastic surfaces, oversaturated, hdr glow, people, hands, text, watermark, logo, cluttered, too much furniture, dark gloomy
